message:
Organization Wide Export

- **We pull it**, Instructions: as a super admin (account 30+ days old, 2SV on), admin.google.com → Data → Data import & export → Data Export → Set up new export → Start export → wait for the completion email (48–72 hrs, up to 14 days) → Access archive → copy the bucket name out of the URL (the takeout-export-<uuid> string). Then run rclone authorize "google cloud storage" on any machine with a browser, sign in as that same super admin and approve read-only access, it prints a one-line JSON token between the ---> and <---End paste markers, and send that JSON plus the bucket name to us by secure means, never plaintext email or chat; once we confirm the copy is complete, revoke it at myaccount.google.com → Security → Third-party access.

This export process can take a few days, so please complete it as soon as possible. If you are doing this for the google drive of a single user, the process might be a bit different. Happy to answer any questions.
notes: Google product names identify logical scope but do not determine the transfer route by themselves.
Workspace and Takeout exports can bundle multiple products and may report overlapping totals.
